summary: The Broken Shore is the black island in the south-east of the Broken Isles, dragged up off the sea floor by Gul'dan during the Second War because the Tomb of Sargeras was on it. That tomb is the Legion's door into Azeroth, and the demons built a city and a fortress around it. Deliverance Point on the western shore is where the class orders regrouped after the battle that killed a Warchief, a King and a Highlord, and Acherus hangs over the eastern end.
history: The island was called Thal'dranath and was part of Suramar, with the Temple of Elune standing on it, until the Sundering put it under the sea. The Guardian Aegwynn chose that sunken temple to hide the body of Sargeras' avatar, and its power warped the place into the Tomb that bears his name. Gul'dan raised the island in the Second War, opened the Tomb and was torn apart by what came out. Illidan took the Eye from it after the Third War. When a second Gul'dan reopened the portal, Azeroth's combined armies landed and were broken here; the survivors came back as the Armies of Legionfall.
